Khamoshi us cheez ka izzat hai jo na boli gayi.
Courage dar ka virodh hai, dar par kabja, dar ki kami nahi.
Himmat ek manspeshi hai.
Himmat karna hi karna hai.
Himmat ka raaz tayyari hai.
Shaant dimaag se zyada taqatwar kuch nahi.
Khamoshi weakness nahi—strength hai.
Silence ek great strength ka source hai.
Chalte raho; end nazdeek hai.
Tum lose nahi karte agar learn karte; grow karoge to win.
Bahaduri bhare kaam aatma ko darshate hain.
Grit wahi lagan hai jab duniya kehti hai ruk jao, tab bhi aage badhte rehna.
Chuppi samajhdaaron ka kavach hai.
Jo change nahi ho sakta, usse bear karna courage.
Grit matlab gehri himmat hai.
Grit sach hai.
Khamoshi patli hai.
Silent hona hamesha surrender nahi hota.
Khamoshi chup hai.
Jab alfaaz na kaam karein, khamoshi bolti.
Zarurat ho to bolo.
